messages:
tara_csm: FYI — we detected delayed embedding ingestion for ~9 onboarding tenants after a deploy. A couple are flagged for renewal conversations. Need a short status note and a plan for outreach.

ben_cs: list the tenants? i'll prioritize the two renewal-risk and handle outreach.

tara_csm: posted tenant list in drive (link). delays show as timeouts on large multi-file imports between 09:10-09:32 UTC. no errors indicating data loss.

kevin_se: quick tech note for customers: a deploy introduced a throttling regression in the batch fetcher causing temporary timeouts for large imports. rolled back at 09:33 UTC and kicked off catch-up jobs. processing rate back to normal; backlog ~5k files.

mia_ops: confirm no corruption — we replayed queued jobs and can fast-track two renewal-risk tenants. estimate full catch-up 1-4 hours per tenant.

sam_support: i'll open support tickets and use a short template. want to offer credits or assistance?

tara_csm: suggest message: short apology, assurance of no data loss, ETA window, offer account credit or expedited replay + 1:1 onboarding help for renewal-risk customers. keep tone empathetic.

ben_cs: send me the draft for the two renewal-risk tenants; i'll call first then follow up by email.

kevin_se: RCA blurb (customer-facing): "Cause: a deployment introduced a temporary throttling change in our batch ingestion service, which caused delays for some large imports. We rolled back the change and are replaying queued jobs; no data was lost."

incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-310 created: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-310 1: status: mitigated, severity: P2, notes: deploy rollback, backlog draining.

tara_csm: draft outgoing (will send in 10m unless edits):

Hi <Customer Name>,

We wanted to let you know you may experience a delay in embedding ingestion for imports started between 09:10-09:33 UTC. We rolled back the change that caused the issue and are replaying queued jobs. No data was lost.

Expected timeframe: most imports will complete within 1 hours; we'll update your support ticket with an ETA.

If this impacts a launch or milestone, reply and we'll assign a dedicated engineer and offer account credit or a complimentary onboarding session.

We'll follow up with a short RCA within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Tara (Customer Success)

sam_support: approved. creating tickets + templates now.

tara_csm: action items: 1) sam: tickets + template (5m) 2) ben: call top renewal-risk tenant then email (15m) 3) kevin/mia: deliver 48h RCA + prioritized replay status. post any customer replies here. :pray:
